manifest_note: Declared providers. Each is registered, discoverable and inventoried; none declares an entry_point yet, so each certifies CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL and is refused activation until an implementation is pointed at it. Adding that implementation is a two-line manifest edit plus a module - no framework change (PC-14).

providers.description: Provides documentation units as attested resources.

capabilities.name: documentation.documents
capabilities.description: Enumerate documentation units matching a selector.

capabilities.name: documentation.document
capabilities.description: Resolve one documentation unit by identity.

capabilities.name: documentation.attestation
capabilities.description: Attest a documentation unit's content hash and provenance.
